title: Sunday Daily Practice
subtitle: Class day: light practice with comparison phrases and Part 1
source: Daily Practice tuần 2 (print/I3/Daily_Practice_Week2_source.md), bài I3 Leisure and Recreation
intro: Sunday is a class day, so this is a light task, about 30 minutes. Before class (5 minutes, not submitted): read aloud the 6 comparison phrases from Friday once, then reread your rewritten Introduction and Overview. After class, do the 2 steps below. Deadline 23:00 the same day. Complete and on time earns 20 Meow; late or half done earns 10 Meow. Do not look at the answers before you finish.

steps.title: Step 1 · Three sentences
steps.instructions: Write 3 sentences comparing two things in your life (two sports, two cities, two weekends). Use 3 DIFFERENT phrases from Friday's 6: considerably higher than, slightly lower than, twice as much as, the highest proportion of, whereas, by far the most popular.

open.model: Football is by far the most popular sport in my class. Hanoi is considerably more crowded than Hue. I study at home on weekdays, whereas I play sport at weekends.

steps.title: Step 2 · Speaking Part 1 voice note
steps.instructions: Answer the question in one voice note of about 40 seconds, following the Answer, Reason, Example, Contrast pattern. Use at least 2 vocabulary words from this week.
lines: Do you prefer team sports or individual sports?
steps.note: Thầy sẽ nghe và nhận xét 4 bước Answer, Reason, Example, Contrast.

send_today: Hoàn thành 2 bước trên web. Voice note ở Step 2 sẽ được gửi tự động cho thầy khi bấm Nộp bài.
